name: a product panel steps from checkout to shipped
looks: A small order panel holds a frame colour row, a size row and a price, with the buy button sitting ready underneath. It crossfades into the same panel showing a shipping status instead: a label reading on its way, a day, and a slim progress bar most of the way across.
build: The frame/size options are static rows with a selection ring on the active one; the panel crossfades to the shipping state; the progress bar's fill and the day label are set from one value with no easing, read-only once shipped.
sound: A soft tick as the panel's state crossfades and a light confirm tone under the progress bar.
prompt: Hold a small order panel with its options and a price, then morph it in place into a shipping-status version of the same panel, a short label and a slim progress bar most of the way filled, so the purchase and its fulfilment read as one continuous panel.
